title:
Farcaster: What the devs are working on this week:
-Clanker: getting v5 ready to roll out n...
summary:
1. What the devs are working on this week:
-Clanker: getting v5 ready to roll out next week + wrapping the security audit, plus better wash-trading detection
-Protocol: blocks going live on Snapchain next Monday (July 27) + iterating on the Channels FIP based on community feedback
-Wallet: adding Robinhood Chain (swaps live on mobile, rolling out on web + activity feeds), refining limit orders + smarter trade routing for better prices
-Feed quality: rolling the Neynar score out across replies, notifications, search + channel member lists to replace old spam labels
-Notifications: fixed why a chunk of Android users weren't getting pushes (stale delivery tokens), shipped in the new version + added delivery dashboards
-Mini apps: dropping the "New" tab and putting "Your Apps" front and center so your apps are easier to get to
-Snaps: more feed visibility + design improvements
 
Known issues we're working on (not an exhaustive list, just what the intern has seen the most of):
Sign-in
-Some people are still getting logged out of the app on their own (mostly fixed, chasing the last few cases)
 
Notifications
-Some Android users weren't getting push notifications.
2. Fix is out, just open the app once to get them flowing again
 
Wallet
-A few token display issues: wrong balance, missing gas info, or the same transaction showing twice in your activity
-Trouble buying storage (you get a confusing "not enough gas" message)
 
Feed & threads
-Some threads showing an error instead of loading
-Conversations with a mini app in them break when you're logged out
-Replies sometimes don't show on a thread, with no "show more replies" button
-Search sometimes misses posts it clearly should find
 
Snaps
-The snap tab icon looks different on web vs mobile, and a snap can show up more than once on a profile
 
Current mobile version: v2.1.12 (559)
 
What did I miss?
author: Farcaster
